pvaResearch.title: PVA geometry diagnostics
pvaResearch.description: Inspect how each transient method, passive reference, and retained beat behaves before any PVA quantity is promoted to a product output.
pvaResearch.boundaryTitle: An unqualified generic PVA is not established
pvaResearch.boundaryDescription: {{supported}} of {{attempted}} method rows establishes a domain-supported PVA under either passive reference. The values below are research diagnostics: accepted open-path work, synthetic closure sensitivity, systolic extrapolation, and observed-domain area strips.

qualification.title: Method-specific PVA output
qualification.description: One analysis transaction reuses a single periodic source for the transient preload family and three-grid mechanical work, and solves the fixed intrinsic passive reference alongside them. The completed result returns the versioned LV and RV estimates with their limitations.

limitation.systolic-relation-extrapolation-required: The systolic relation is extrapolated beyond the measured preload range
limitation.baseline-exclusion-sensitive: The estimate is sensitive to excluding the baseline beat
limitation.phase-resolution-sensitive: The estimate changes beyond the declared 64-to-128 phase threshold
limitation.selected-phase-state-dispersion-retained: The selected phase does not identify one common myocardial state across preload beats
limitation.protocol-direction-sensitivity-retained: Occlusion and release slopes retain direction sensitivity
limitation.fixed-contralateral-intrinsic-passive-re: The intrinsic passive slice fixes the contralateral ventricular volume

qualification.executionMode: Execution: explicit on-demand completed-protocol analysis. This screen reads the last checked-in result and never reruns the model during ordinary rendering.
qualification.claimBoundary: This is a versioned method-specific estimate, not generic or clinical PVA, oxygen consumption, or a live single-beat output. Product publication still requires cached execution outside this research view.

modelLimitations.title: Research model limitations
items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.
A 0D lumped-parameter model cannot resolve spatial blood flow, local wall stress, or three-dimensional hemodynamics.
The current exact V3 package is an experimental development default. It does not claim release readiness, simulation readiness, or clinical validation.
Parameters and outputs are approximations and require validation for each intended scientific use.

PV panes default to a responsive fixed-TBV multi-load PV-loop support-envelope preview, which is not qualified evidence. Their optional formal mode admits only full-state period-1 qualified loads, but remains a numerical analysis rather than independent physiological or clinical validation, PVA, or oxygen-consumption evidence.

The Guyton / Starling response starts from a locally period-1-settled operating anchor with slow coronary tone frozen. Off-centre adaptive points are preview data; nonconverged or period-2 boundary points are excluded from the connected curve, and the result is not canonical qualified evidence.
